LM19-U07.name: Here He Comes! Our Ultraman!
LM19-U07.effect:
[Core Charge: ("Ultraman" & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Gandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Grand Field] [LV1][LV2]
Once per turn, when your "Ultraman" Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can put a core from this Nexus to each of those Spirits. Spirits which had cores put on them by this effect remain on the Field in the same state.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Every "Ultraman" Spirit you control gains +5000 BP, and is treated as being on its highest level.

LM19-U08.name: Spacium Ray
LM19-U08.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by the effect of your "Ultraman" Spirit/Spirit card, or sent to the Trash by your exactly-named "Here He Comes! Our Ultraman!", you can add it to the Hand. When you've done so, +1 core to any of your exactly-named "Here He Comes! Our Ultraman!".

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. Or, if you control any "Ultraman" Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus, destroy an opposing Cost 8 or less Spirit/Ultimate. This effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Armor].

LM19-U06.name: Taiga's Father Ultraman Tarou
LM19-U06.effect:
Main- [Accel: Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core])]
Reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, deploy a Cost 4 or less Blue Nexus card without paying the cost, and add an "Ultraman" Spirit card to the Hand. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 9 or less Spirit.

LM19-U02.name: Ultraman Fuma
LM19-U02.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to either your Blue Nexus, or to another "Ultraman" Spirit you control.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw two cards, then discard a card from your Hand. When this effect discards any "Ultraman", destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit.

LM19-U04.name: Ultraman Ruebe
LM19-U04.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Blue & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Destroy every opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. When [advents] on an "Ultraman" Spirit, instead, destroy every opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can refresh a Spirit you control. When you've done so, during this turn, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

LM19-U01.name: Ultraman Taiga
LM19-U01.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "Here He Comes! Our Ultraman!", and a Cost 4 or more "Ultraman" Spirit card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon an "Ultraman Titus"/"Ultraman Fuuma" Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

LM19-U03.name: Ultraman Titas
LM19-U03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
During this turn, this Spirit is treated as being on its highest level.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this battle, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest cost.

LM19-U05.name: Ultraman Orb Dark Noir Black Schwarz
LM19-U05.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
Send three cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve, and summon this card without paying the cost. Then, if your Life is three or less, send five cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexus(es) to the Void and, if it's the opponent's Main Step, end this turn.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with three or less cores on it. The cores on a Spirit destroyed by this effect are sent to the Trash, not the Reserve.
